# Asia Semiconductor Supply Tightens, Prices Surge Fast  
**Bottom line:** Expect higher costs and longer lead times; lock in pricing where advised and push for volume discounts this week.  

## What changed  
- Market supply risk stays high at 66.9 (down 0.1) and price trend climbs to 86.8 (up 0.1) [source 1].  
- Producer price index (+32.6% annualized) and record global chip sales (+148.3% YoY) are driving tighter supply and higher prices [1][2].  
- Fab utilization remains below 10‑yr average (74.4% vs 80.0%) providing a modest loosening pressure, but TSMC revenue (+56.0% YoY) and Korea export surge (+100% YoY) offset it, keeping overall risk elevated [3][4][5].  

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1  
- Lead time **14 weeks**; channel stock **27,071** units (≈17.6 weeks of supply).  
- No on‑order PBO; next arrival not scheduled.  
- Price **$5.56** / unit (qty 1) and **$2.51** / unit (qty 1k).  
- Origin **Austria**, tariff **0 %** (no surcharge).  
- Call: **Lock pricing (no need to buy ahead)** – 70 % chance prices rise in 3 months, but supply is adequate; fix price now, keep normal order cadence [featured_part].  

## Alerts  
- **PBO delayed** – ATMEGA328P‑AU: next arrival slipped from 2026‑11‑25 → 2026‑12‑10 (9,500 on order) [alerts].  
- **Backorder easing** – MT40A1G16TB‑062E:F: PBO arriving (1,020 → 0 on order, stock 5,002 → 6,022) [alerts].  

## Segment board  
- Processors & advanced logic – Supply 66.3 (↓0.1), Price 83.8 [segments].

## Your BOM watchlist  
- **10M08SAE144C8G** – lead time 52 weeks (norm 12 wks) → supply risk 77.3.  
- **LCMXO2-1200HC-4TG100C** – lead time 52.1 weeks → supply risk 77.3.

- **LM358DR** – lead time 26 weeks → supply risk 76.0.

## Outlook  
- Chip prices likely to rise in the next 3 months: 77 % probability, expected +7.05 % (80 % range –4.66 % to 18.76 %); model‑tested edge [forecast].  
- 6‑month price rise probability 76 %, expected +14.1 % (range –1.13 % to 29.33 %); baseline trend [forecast].  
- Fab utilization may tighten modestly (3‑mo p_up 52 %, expected +0.12 pts) and 6‑mo p_up 51 %, expected +0.23 pts; both baseline forecasts [forecast].  
- Buy‑timing: lock pricing for parts like IPB017N10N5ATMA1; buy ahead for high‑risk items listed in the “Buy ahead / lock pricing” set.  

## Negotiation angle  
1. **Lock price now** on IPB017N10N5ATMA1 and other “Lock pricing” parts; cite the 70 % upside price risk and adequate 14‑week supply.  
2. **Request volume rebates** for the five watchlist items with >50 week lead times; their supply risk scores (≈77) give leverage for better terms.
